diagnostics.label: malformed with statement
causes: `with` statements must use `with resource as name { ... }`.

fixes.title: Rewrite this construct using the currently supported RSScript syntax.

diagnostics.summary: return in `copy_setting` has type `Unit`, expected `Result<Unit, String>`.
diagnostics.label: return type mismatch
causes: RSScript return types are part of the review contract and must be checked before Rust lowering.

fixes.title: Return a value of type `Result<Unit, String>` here.

diagnostics.label: unknown callee

fixes.title: Declare the function or add a builtin signature for this API.

diagnostics.summary: arithmetic operators are only built in for numeric values.
diagnostics.label: operator on non-numeric value
causes: RSScript does not support user-defined operator overloads.

fixes.title: Use a named function such as `Type.add(left: read a, right: read b)`.
